title: CRF450R Motocross (Race Replica)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Honda CRF450R Motocross (Race Replica) is engineered for responsive agility and high-rpm engine exhilaration. At its heart lies a 450cc powertrain delivering 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 163 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 13.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
